description: A vehicle USD (--vehicle-asset) on 4 inflatable ANCF FEM tires (--tire-asset) on flat ground: MuJoCo rigid vehicle <-> ANCF bead coupling. run-examples.sh asks which vehicle USD to load (default: the Sherp); the tire follows the vehicle (defaultTireAsset in the vehicle USD) unless tire-asset is set. Vehicles: superjeep_vehicle.usdc (Chrono double wishbone; rim bottom-out stops only, the FEM tires carry ~1490 kg/corner; validated 2026-09-09 at kn=20k, E=50 MPa, alpha-damp 0.15, thickness 0.01: settles at h=0.42 m, 14-17 kN/corner) or sherp_vehicle.usdc + sherp_ancf_tire.usda (rigid hull, fixed axles, skid steer). kn null = the tire asset's recommendation (scaled with node area); kd null = kn x 42/20000; pcg-iters 10 = the locked solver budget (substeps 10 / nr 2 / pcg 10) in every config, whatever the tire asset's pcgIters says. thickness null = the tire asset's recommendation (superjeep_tire: the validated uniform 0.01; Sherp: its baked bands). Steer / speed limits, camera and the CTIS panel come from the vehicle asset.
